name: artifact-explorer
description: A catalog of your claude.ai artifacts on your own machine: one local page to search, sort and reopen everything you made or were sent.

watch_interval.title: Watcher interval (minutes)
watch_interval.description: How often the background watcher scans browser history and transcripts and rebuilds the page. One pass per interval across all sessions.

browser_history.title: Read browser history
browser_history.description: Find artifacts you opened in a browser by reading a copy of the history of Chrome, Chromium, Edge, Brave, Arc, Vivaldi and Firefox. Only claude.ai artifact URLs are kept.

transcript_reads.title: Read session transcripts
transcript_reads.description: Find artifacts Claude published or read in earlier sessions by scanning ~/.claude/projects. Only Artifact tool lines are read.

chrome_screenshots.title: Screenshots with Claude in Chrome
chrome_screenshots.description: Let the screenshots skill capture thumbnails for artifacts that have no local file. Off by default. Needs the Claude in Chrome extension.

share_harvest.title: Read sharing state in Chrome
share_harvest.description: Let the sharing skill open each of your artifacts in Chrome and read its Share dialog. Off by default. Needs the Claude in Chrome extension.

describe_model.title: Describer model
describe_model.description: Model alias or full name for the background describer session. A small, fast model is plenty. The describer agent itself always runs on haiku.

describe_daily_cap.title: Daily describer cap (USD)
describe_daily_cap.description: The watcher starts a background describer run only when today's spend plus one run's limit ($0.25) stays within this amount.
